verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents an integrations catalog of '100+' / 'hundreds' of tools that sync for automated evidence collection. The evidence covers several of the story's categories: cloud services (including Azure Government), SSO-based identity detection, native integrations that pull user data, and Jira ticketing sync. Missing for 10: any evidence of read-only or least-privilege scopes; explicit coverage of HR, code-hosting and MDM integrations; per-integration setup documentation; independent or hands-on corroboration.
